title.zh: 编排：轨道音量可有连续包络，渐强渐弱不必再切分段
title.en: Arrangement: a track's level can be a continuous envelope, so a fade is not cut into pieces

highlights.zh: 按 docs/DAW_GAP_ARRANGEMENT.md §8 第 4 项做：点用拍、值用 dB，区间外保持平直（外推会越过 +6 dB 上限），两点之间直线；曲线在编译期展开成每步增益，活引擎与离线渲染共用一份。
highlights.en: Built as docs/DAW_GAP_ARRANGEMENT.md §8's fourth item: points in beats, values in dB, flat outside the points (extrapolating would pass the +6 dB ceiling) and straight between them; the compile expands it to a per-step gain shared by the live engine and the offline renderer.

highlights.zh: 顺带修一处真 bug：活引擎把推子钳在 1.0，而编译一直能写到 2.0（+6 dB）、离线混音也认，同一工程在房间里比在文件里更轻。
highlights.en: A real bug went with it: the live engine clamped the fader at 1.0 while the compile has always been able to write 2.0 (+6 dB) and the offline mixer honoured it, so a project was quieter in the room than in the file.
